transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I keep holding on to this belief that my clients and managers are secretly monitoring and using my translations in ways they deny, and nothing anyone says can convince me otherwise. My wife urged me to come here to talk to someone, but I just can't shake the reality of what they are doing.

Besides these specific beliefs about your work, have you noticed any changes in your ability to express emotions, loss of interest in activities, or a decline in your motivation to take care of daily tasks?

No, I haven't experienced any loss of motivation, changes in my emotions, or loss of interest in my daily activities. I'm still working full-time, paying my bills, and managing my household responsibilities just fine. The only real disruptions in my life are directly tied to avoiding that monitoring, like turning down a promotion or refusing certain trips.
Have you ever experienced hearing voices, seeing things, or sensing sensations that others around you do not seem to perceive?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices, see things, or feel any strange physical sensations. My senses are completely normal, and my mind is clear.
How long have you held these specific beliefs about your managers and clients, and have these thoughts ever led you to report them to any authorities or take legal action?

This has been going on for about eleven months now, starting right after a tense video call where they disputed my translation terminology. I haven't reported them to any authorities or taken legal action, but it has led me to turn down a major promotion and has caused arguments with my wife about traveling.

Do you believe that your managers and clients are using technology or methods that are physically possible for them to access, or do you feel they are using supernatural or impossible means to monitor you?

It is completely realistic and physical, not supernatural at all. They are dissecting my technical translations line by line and tracking me through the phrasing in their emails and "random" quality audits. It is a highly technical, plausible operation that they manage entirely through our standard work systems.
Have you ever used any substances, such as stimulants or alcohol, or been diagnosed with any medical conditions that might explain why you feel they are monitoring you?
No, I don't use stimulants, and I only drink alcohol occasionally in moderation. I also don't have any medical conditions that could explain why they are monitoring my work.

Besides these beliefs about your workplace, have you ever felt that other people, such as your neighbors, friends, or strangers in public, are also involved in this situation or have similar intentions toward you?

No, not at all. This situation is strictly limited to my workplace, my clients, and the company management. I have never felt that my neighbors, friends, or strangers in public are involved or have any intentions like this toward me.
